integrity: Two self-contained, distinct exhaustive Python verifiers using direct tree pairs and contracted Laplacian determinants; finite exact computations, no external certificate claims.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite result specific to the Petersen graph; general base-exchange geodesic identity and the 2000-tree count are previously known. Possible unindexed equivalent computations and incomplete access to a Petersen-matroid manuscript. No independent review.
title: Seventy central spanning trees in the Petersen exchange graph
